title: Exactness of the formal glueing complex
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a flat ring map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], $f_1,\dots,f_t\in R$ and $I=(f_1,\dots,f_t)$, such that the induced map $R/I\to S/IS$ is an isomorphism. For an $R$-module $M$ let $M\otimes_RS$ be its base change [def-weil-module-base-change], $M_{f_i}$, $M_{f_if_j}$ its localizations [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away], and identify $(M\otimes_RS)_{f_i}$ with $M_{f_i}\otimes_RS$ canonically. Consider the sequence $0\to M\xrightarrow{\alpha}(M\otimes_RS)\times\prod_iM_{f_i}\xrightarrow{\beta}\prod_i(M\otimes_RS)_{f_i}\times\prod_{i,j}M_{f_if_j}$ with $\alpha(m)=(m\otimes1,m/1,\dots,m/1)$ and $\beta(m',(m_i)_i)=\big((m'/1-m_i\otimes1)_i,(m_i/1-m_j/1)_{i,j}\big)$ (the images of $m_i\in M_{f_i}$, $m_j\in M_{f_j}$ in $M_{f_if_j}$). Then this sequence is exact: $\alpha$ is injective and $\operatorname{Ker}\beta=\operatorname{Im}\alpha$.
